name: Greggs
covers: Food and drinks in UK Greggs shops
headline: Cappuccino, hot chocolate and mocha may contain wheat.
tips: Drinks: cappuccino, hot chocolate, mocha and some speciality drinks may contain wheat. Lattes, flat whites, teas and the syrups list no gluten cereal.
Almost all the bakery, sandwiches, bakes and sweet treats contain wheat. Look at drinks, fruit pots, dips and crisps.
Greggs marks a few items GF (its gluten free label), such as the Tomato Soup. Its porridge is marked GF but made with oats, so it's on the Avoid list here.
gaps: Greggs calls a few products gluten free (marked GF). This app lists items with no gluten cereal marked, and quotes Greggs' claim on the items it labels.
A bullet in the guide means an item may contain that cereal; those items are on the Avoid list here, with the reason.
The guide says hot and iced drinks can't be guaranteed allergen-free because of shared equipment.
Branded products: the guide says their allergen details are on the packaging or the supplier's website.
